benign_text.text: Classic tomato soup: simmer onions and garlic, add canned tomatoes and stock, blend and serve with warm bread. Serves four.
Apple pie from scratch. Peel six apples, toss with cinnamon and sugar, fill the crust and bake until golden. Call it dessert.
Scammers pretending to be Microsoft are calling older adults and claiming their computers have viruses. Police say never allow a stranger remote access and never pay with gift cards.
benign_text.note: news about scams on unknown host

benign_text.text: Tech support scams: how to spot them. Real companies do not send pop-up warnings with a phone number. If you see a fake virus alert, do not call the number. Close the browser and run a scan.
Report fraud. Scammers say your computer is locked or hacked and ask you to pay with gift cards, bitcoin or a wire transfer. Stop and tell someone you trust.

Protect yourself from tech support scams. Microsoft will never send unsolicited pop-ups asking you to call a number about viruses or malware. Windows Defender runs quietly and does not ask for payment.
Consumer alert: do not call numbers in pop-ups claiming a virus. Contact support only through the official site. Hacked accounts should be reported.
Card help. If your card is blocked or your online access is locked, call the number on the back of your card, for example 1-800-555-0131, weekdays 8 to 8.
benign_text.note: bank help page on unknown host

benign_text.text: Package delayed? If your delivery is blocked at the depot call our helpline 1-877-555-0132 with your tracking code. Never share your password.
benign_text.note: shipping help with phone and blocked

benign_text.text: Release notes 4.2: added dark mode on Windows, fixed a crash on Apple silicon, improved startup time.
Version 9.1 supports Windows 11 and macOS. Apple users should update to the latest system before installing.

Buy gift cards for any occasion. Choose a design, pick an amount and send by email. Gift cards never expire.
Ten tips to speed up an old laptop: remove unused programs, check startup items, add memory and keep Windows updated.

benign_text.text: Virus season is here: flu shots available at the clinic. Call 1-800-555-0141 to book. Appointments blocked out on Sundays.
How to avoid fake virus warnings. If a page says Do not close this window, close it anyway using Task Manager. Real Windows alerts never list a phone number.
Garden diary: the apple trees need pruning in winter. The old windows of the greenhouse were replaced last spring.
Mobile plan help. If your SIM is blocked after three wrong PIN entries, call 1-888-555-0144 to unlock it. Hours 9 to 5.
FBI warning: criminals impersonating tech support are targeting seniors. Report to ic3.gov. Never send bitcoin or gift cards to someone who contacts you.
